༄༅/ /rmi lam 'dzin lugs bzhugs so/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padma dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor sdong po tshul khrims lo 'dab

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rmi lam 'dzin lugs bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padma dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor sdong po tshul khrims lo 'dab rgyas/ /thos bsam rnam dag ting 'dzin me tog bkra/ /nyams rtogs 'bum phrag dpag med 'bras bus brgyan/ /mkhas grub chos rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan dpe'i me tog bslab gsum dri/ /mkhyen brtse'i ze'u 'bru dri med sku/ /mthong thos dran pas yid 'phrog par/ /mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo rgyud mkha' la lung rigs kyi/ /chu 'dzin man ngag glog 'gyu ba/ /stong nyid 'brug sgra chos char 'bebs/ /smra ba'i skyes mchog phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' bral chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /'gag med gzugs sku'i rta bdun rgyas/ /'gro ba'i mun sel lam mchog ston/ /mkha' ltar dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du bkra lam me ba la dmigs pa gtad nas gnyid log pas/ rmi lam zin pa dang / yul snang gtan la phebs pa dus mnyam du 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa/ as 'phul snang rang gsal ni/ gsol ba btab la rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i rtsa dbu ma phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang du me tog sor bzhir/ a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig la/ nyin mtshan med par rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /des lus kyi phyi nang dang / phyi'i yul snang thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba 'byung ngo / /gsum pa/ thig les yul snang gsal byed ni/ gsol ba btab la rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor haṃ las thig le dkar po snying gar byung / gsang gnas kyi hūm̐ dang / lte ba'i aṃ las thig le dmar po snying gar byung ste/ yi ge gsum po 'od du phrug phrug 'dug pa la gcig tu gyur nas rang gi snying gi dkyil du/ thig le 'od kyi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med par bsam/ de la 'od dkar byung nas rang gi sna bug nas phar 'phros te/ gang lta bar 'dod pa de'i thugs khar bcug la rang gi snying kha'i thig le dang /

de gnyis 'od ba thag lta bu'i sbrel ba/ skya nar re ba de la sems gtad do/ /de rnams kyis yul snang ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa/ 'od gsal la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas ni/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba la skyo shas drag po bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ yal ga spyod lam dam rdzas ni/ spyod lam dal la kha zas snum/ /rngul thon las rnams spang bar bya'o/ /dam rdzas ni tshogs dang gtor ma bzang du bshams la dbul/ gu gul dang / tshil chen gyi dud pa btang / thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs nas/ dar ram ras kyi dril la sngas 'og du gzhug mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rten 'brel lo/ /la kha thal na snying rlung du 'gro ba srid pa 'dug de'i gnyen por snying rje mkhan rang su yin/ yul gang la snying rje/ tshul ji ltar snying rje bsam pa la sogs pas mi rtag pa phyag rgya chen po la 'jog pa gal che bar 'dug gsung ngo / /bla mas yi dam gyi gtso bo gang la bgyis zhus pas/ dang po bde mchog la byas/ zhag re la yi ge bdun pa khri tsho gsum tsam re thon gyin 'dug de nas rmi lam bzung nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gsol ba mgrin gcig tu 'debs par bsams nas bdag gi yi dam gyi lha gang lags zhes gsung du gsol zhes gsol ba drag po btab pas/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum byon nas/ btsun pa'i yi dam thugs rje chen po yin mod gsung / de nas thugs rje chen po la yi dam gtso bor byas gsung / de nas dang po rmi lam du zhal mthong / phyis dngos su zhal 'ga' re mthong gsung / yi dam gzhan zhal gzigs sam zhus pas ('di'i rgyab shog ma dper mi tshang bar bya thabs bral/) PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 ngag dbang chos grags pa/ rmi lam 'dzin lugs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
